note: The beacon diagnosis (Exec Summary step 3, Technical Strategy BEACON_DIAGNOSIS) and the briefing after it. Once Arthur and Daniel are in (SAILORS_INSIDE, DANIEL_IN_BASEMENT) Ted, now in the lamp room, calls the player up (BEACON_STILL_DARK); the player climbs to the lamp room (LAMP_ROOM_ENTERED), Ted takes out the broken burner (BURNER_DIAGNOSED: it appears on the floor beside him, then Ted names the ship); back down in the hall the player is briefed (BURNER_BRIEFING) and sent to the Saltgate with Arthur. The same lamp-room zone fires LAMP_ROOM_REENTERED later, when the player comes back carrying the replacement burner. scripts/world/diagnosis_sequence.gd reads this file.
still_dark_note: Seconds after Arthur is in the hall and Daniel is in the basement before Ted shouts for the player ('Dynamo's running and still no light').

ted.note: Beside the arc lamp, off the player's route to the burner seat (tools/probe_ted_spot.gd), next to where the broken burner lies. Ted appears when he calls the player up.

open_note: Seconds after the player reaches the lamp room before Ted has the burner out and says it is cracked (BURNER_DIAGNOSED). Ted's first line, 'Arc lamp's in the middle. Let's open her up...', fills the time.

hall.note: The briefing fires when the player is back in the hall near Arthur (the end of his baked walk-in) after the diagnosis.

idle_step3.note: After the briefing, if the player has not cast off, IDLE_STEP_3 nudges (Arthur's ladder: hint, sharper, explicit).
